the understanding of cellular source of antigen specific IFNs in active VL patients and the factors that are responsible for this phenomenon.
the identification of cell type responsible for the antigen driven IFNg production in WBA and the role of soluble complements and antibodies in the production.
the understanding of the immunological mechanisms of the disease.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WBA is a useful tool to monitor the disease progression, treatment and immune reconstitution in VL patients.
CD4+ T-cells are the main source for IFNγ production in the WBA of active VL patients and this response is independent of soluble complements or antibodies.

the WBA is a simple, rapid, and robust tool to measure the IFNγ production in VL patients.
